problem.title: Calculate Digit Sum of A String

approaches.title: Repeatedly sum digits in fixed-size groups
approaches.summary: Partition the current string into groups of up to k digits, append each group’s digit sum, and repeat until the string has at most k characters. The first revision uses recursion; the second performs the same process iteratively while reusing a StringBuilder.

revisions.shortChangeSummary: Build the next string from each group’s digit sum, then recursively process it until its length is at most k.

revisions.rawCommitSubject: java 2243: reuse StringBuilder and unroll recursion
revisions.shortChangeSummary: Replace recursion with a loop and reuse a StringBuilder across iterations.
